Overview.Name: R Ponni Lakshmi
Overview.Goal: Improve overall health and hormonal balance while reducing body fat through simple, consistent meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2–3 whole eggs pan fried in coconut oil + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + small fruit
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 small cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish curry + rice + vegetable stir fry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid all dairy due to allergy. Use coconut oil for cooking.
Keep meals simple and home cooked to support hormonal balance.
Limit spicy foods if digestion feels heavy or bloated.
If hunger appears between meals, prefer eggs or puffed rice instead of packaged snacks.
Maintain consistent meal timings to help regulate hormones.
Increase daily steps gradually toward 6,000–7,000 for better fat loss.
Manage stress with yoga and short walks, as stress can affect hormonal balance.
Stay well hydrated through the day with plain water.
